reported.title: Fill valve drops out because FILL is left on a single noisy sample
reported.description: The state machine in loop() only advances IDLE->FILL when levelCm < EMPTY_CM (line 73) and FILL->RUN when levelCm >= FULL_CM (line 77); there is no path that keeps the valve HIGH while the level is still below 25 cm once a transient pushes the reading up. readLevelCm() (lines 28-33) takes a single unfiltered analogRead, so a brief spike above 25 cm moves the state to RUN and driveOutputs() (line 37) then drives D9 LOW. Measured: in the spike scenario D9 was not HIGH for 5870 ms from 2.13 s, and in the glitch scenario for 1370 ms from 1.13 s. D9 was in the wrong state for 6350 ms across 5 interval(s), first at 1.13 s: D9 was not HIGH for 1370 ms while required (grace 100 ms).

reported.title: Motor stays HIGH below 20 cm and never starts at high level
reported.description: There is no RUN->IDLE transition at all: loop() checks only IDLE->FILL (line 73) and FILL->RUN (line 77), so once in ST_RUN the motor on D10 stays HIGH regardless of level, violating the 600 ms drop-out requirement (measured: D10 not LOW for 870 ms from 1.63 s in the glitch scenario). Conversely, entering RUN requires passing through FILL, so at a level already above 20 cm the motor never turns on (measured: D10 not HIGH for 3400 ms from 0.6 s in the max/min scenario). The single-sample readLevelCm() (lines 28-33) also lets noise flip the state. D10 was in the wrong state for 3850 ms across 5 interval(s), first at 1.63 s: D10 was not LOW for 870 ms while required (grace 600 ms).

truth.description: RUN state never exits when level drops

truth_for_judge.description: RUN state never exits when level drops

exposing_checks.behaviour: D10 must follow its stimulus; LOW when A0 < 20; within 600 ms (Motor off below 20 cm)

judge_input.spec:
- Level probe on A0 at 10 mV/cm; fill valve on D9; drum motor on D10; reset on D4 (pull-up).
- States: IDLE (both outputs OFF), FILL (valve D9 HIGH until level >= 25.0 cm), RUN (motor D10 HIGH while level stays >= 20.0 cm), then IDLE.
- Leave RUN and return to IDLE when level drops below 20.0 cm; motor D10 must go LOW within 600 ms.
- Enter FILL from IDLE when level is below 10.0 cm.
- Holding D4 LOW forces IDLE immediately.
- Print `laundry st=<0|1|2> cm=<n>` every 1000 ms.

truth_bugs.description: RUN state never exits when level drops

exposing_checks.behaviour: D10 must follow its stimulus; LOW when A0 < 20; within 600 ms (Motor off below 20 cm)
